name: mailsort
description: Portable email triage for Gmail and Microsoft 365: ten stable categories (Don't Miss, Needs Reply, To Do, Screener, Receipts, Alerts, News, CC, Later, Black Hole), context-checked reply drafts, a morning brief, backlog sweeps, and exportable client-side filter rules. Reads and organizes mail; never sends, deletes, or unsubscribes without the owner saying so. Composio recommended for connectivity; native connectors supported.
